tutorial.title: Tutorial
tutorial.step_1_desc: Two paths lie before you: a deep reading or the contemplation of the letter of the day.
tutorial.step_2_desc: Select the letters that call to you, or let the unseen choose for you.
tutorial.step_3_desc: Arrange your space according to your feeling: in a fan, a grid, or the heart of chaos.
tutorial.step_4_desc: Dive into the deep layers of each letter to grasp its spiritual whisper.
tutorial.step_5_desc: Discover the secret alchemy linking your two letters, and the message they weave together.
tutorial.step_6_desc: Articulate what dwells in your mind and entrust it to the wisdom of Kabbalah.
tutorial.step_7_desc: Converse with our virtual expert to illuminate your doubts and refine your understanding.
tutorial.step_8_desc: Receive an intimate and benevolent message to accompany your personal journey.
tutorial.step_9_desc: Do not simply read: feel and embody the vibration of your letter.
tutorial.step_10_desc: Put your body in motion and trace the letters in space through Tehima.
tutorial.step_11_desc: Breathe and meditate to the rhythm of the symbol to anchor its light within you.

support.title: Letter of support
support.letter_text:
Dear traveler,

What you have traversed today calls for neither resolution nor conclusion.

The letters ask for nothing. They promise nothing. They hold a space — a space you have agreed to look at.

There is nothing to achieve. There is nothing to fix. What has opened remains open as long as you wish.

Take the time to let these symbols rest within you. They will work at their own pace, without your effort.

The silence that follows is as precious as the words that preceded it.

experience.title: Experience your letter
experience.meditation_desc: Take a moment to sit in silence. Let the voice guide you through the essence of this letter.
experience.tehima_desc: Tehima is the gesture of Hebrew letters. Let your body express the shape and movement of this letter.
experience.calligraphy_desc: Observe the calligrapher's gesture. Let your eyes follow the subtle tracing of ink on parchment.

about.title: About
about.content: Zohar Cards is an application that builds a bridge between the ancient wisdom of Hebrew letters and modern design. Set within a sacred minimalist space, it invites you to draw cards, read deep interpretations, and experience each letter through meditation, Tehima (the dance of letters), or calligraphy. A true journey of introspection and connection to the hidden meaning of the world.
